106-progress.name: Tommy Joe Stonefield
106-progress.text: You have what??  Maybell is the light of my dull life.  Hurry, let me see her letter!
106-progress.title: Young Lovers

107-progress.name: William Pestle
107-progress.text: You have a note from "Gramma" Stonefield, eh?  I haven't seen Mildred in years!  I wonder what she has to say...
107-progress.title: Note to William

11-progress.name: Deputy Rainer
11-progress.text: Hail, $N.  Have you been killing Gnolls...?
11-progress.title: Riverpaw Gnoll Bounty

112-progress.name: William Pestle
112-progress.text: Do you have that crystal kelp?  I'm sure Maybell is anxious to see her beau...
112-progress.title: Collecting Kelp

114-progress.name: Maybell Maclure
114-progress.text: Did you deliver my letter to Tommy Joe?  What did he say??
114-progress.title: The Escape

12-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
12-progress.text: Perhaps I did not make myself clear, pledge.  In order to prove your worth as a servant to The People's Militia and to the Light you need to slay 15 Defias Trappers and 15 Defias Smugglers then return to me when the deed is done.
12-progress.title: The People's Militia

132-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
132-progress.text: Good to see you back, $N.  What did Wiley have to say for himself?
132-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

1338-progress.name: Furen Longbeard
1338-progress.text:
A letter from the dwarven lands?  I wonder who would call from so far to the north...

Please, let me see the order.
1338-progress.title: Stormpike's Order

135-progress.name: Master Mathias Shaw
135-progress.text: What business do you have with me?  I am a very busy man. . .
135-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

14-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
14-progress.text: $N, now is no time for idle chatter.  If you still wish to prove yourself to The People's Militia you need to slay the Defias I notified you about earlier.  Return to me when you have completed your duty.
14-progress.title: The People's Militia

141-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
141-progress.text: Did Master Shaw shed any light on things?
141-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

142-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
142-progress.text: $N, were you able to gather any information?  Did you locate the messenger?
142-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

1638-complete.name: Harry Burlguard
1638-complete.text:
Oh ho!  Have a drink with me, lad.  You look tough on the outside, but let's see if your gut can handle a few mugs of the Pig and Whistle's strongest!!

Or... were you here for a lesson?
1638-complete.title: A Warrior's Training

1665-progress.name: Harry Burlguard
1665-progress.text: I saw your fight with Bartleby.  Nicely done!  Did you get his mug?
1665-progress.title: Bartleby's Mug

1667-progress.name: Marshal Haggard
1667-progress.text: Do you have my badge? I don't want to think of the mischief Dead-tooth Jack could cause with it.
1667-progress.title: Dead-tooth Jack

1681-progress.name: Tormus Deepforge
1681-progress.text: Have you entered Ironband's Compound?  Did you find the umbral ore?
1681-progress.title: Ironband's Compound

176-progress.name: Marshal Dughan
176-progress.text: Yes, Hogger has been a real pain for me and my men.  You have something to report about the beast?
176-progress.title: WANTED: "Hogger"

307-progress.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
307-progress.text: Do you have that Miners' Gear, $N?
307-progress.title: Filthy Paws

312-progress.name: Tundra MacGrann
312-progress.text: Were you able to get into my meat locker, $N?
312-progress.title: Tundra MacGrann's Stolen Stash

353-progress.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
353-progress.text: You come all the way from Stormwind?  I hear it's getting dicey down there in the $r lands, with brigands and orcs running about.  A perfect place for a $c to prove their worth!
353-progress.title: Stormpike's Delivery

36-progress.name: Salma Saldean
36-progress.text: I'm going to miss that Verna Furlbrow so much.  I don't suppose you happened to see her on your way here?
36-progress.title: Westfall Stew

416-progress.name: Mountaineer Kadrell
416-progress.text: Hail, $N.  How goes the rat catching?
416-progress.title: Rat Catching

417-progress.name: Pilot Hammerfoot
417-progress.text: Hello, $N.  Do you have word of my friend Hildelve?
417-progress.title: A Pilot's Revenge

418-progress.name: Vidra Hearthstove
418-progress.text: I'm all ready to start cooking, do you have the ingredients for me?
418-progress.title: Thelsamar Blood Sausages

5545-progress.name: Supervisor Raelen
5545-progress.text: That deadline isn't getting any further away, $c. Please hurry and collect those bundles of wood.
5545-progress.title: A Bundle of Trouble

59-progress.name: Sara Timberlain
59-progress.text:
I have been commissioned by the Stormwind Army to supply their people with cloth and leather armor.

If you have a marker for me, then I'd be happy to make you something.
59-progress.title: Cloth and Leather Armor

6181-progress.name: Thor
6181-progress.text: You look like you're in a hurry.  Well, then you came to the right place!
6181-progress.title: A Swift Message

6261-progress.name: Dungar Longdrink
6261-progress.text: Is that sweat on your brow, lad?  You've been running too much.  Next time, take a gryphon!
6261-progress.title: Dungar Longdrink

6281-progress.name: Osric Strang
6281-progress.text: You've been traveling, eh?  Have you been anywhere interesting?
6281-progress.title: Continue to Stormwind

6285-progress.name: Quartermaster Lewis
6285-progress.text: You're back from Stormwind?  Did Osric send the armor?
6285-progress.title: Return to Lewis

64-progress.name: Farmer Furlbrow
64-progress.text: Don't suppose you were able to get my watch?
64-progress.title: The Forgotten Heirloom

6661-progress.name: Monty
6661-progress.text: Yarrr... Swabby, what be takin' ye so long?
6661-progress.title: Deeprun Rat Roundup

71-progress.name: Guard Thomas
71-progress.text: Hello, $N.  Have you discovered the fates of Rolf and Malakai?
71-progress.title: Report to Thomas

7807-progress.name: Bubulo Acerbus
7807-progress.text:
We are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.  A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by the Gnomeregan Exiles for your generous actions.  Our stores are such on wool that we would only need sixty pieces from you total; we should be able to acquire enough from others in the realm to support our drive.

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
7807-progress.title: A Donation of Wool

83-progress.name: Sara Timberlain
83-progress.text: I'm running low on linen, $N.  Do you have any for me?
83-progress.title: Red Linen Goods

84-progress.name: Billy Maclure
84-progress.text: Ugh... I'm starving!  Do you have that pie for me, $N?
84-progress.title: Back to Billy

86-progress.name: "Auntie" Bernice Stonefield
86-progress.text:
I don't think it's right feeding the boy who stole my necklace in the first place, but if that's what it takes to get back what's mine, then so be it!

Do you have that boar meat?
86-progress.title: Pie for Billy

87-progress.name: "Auntie" Bernice Stonefield
87-progress.text: Hello, $N.  Have you found my necklace?
87-progress.title: Goldtooth

88-progress.name: Ma Stonefield
88-progress.text: Did you see her yet?  Did you get her?
88-progress.title: Princess Must Die!

91732-progress.name: Hagar Lowe
91732-progress.text: Have you been to the mine yet?
91732-progress.title: Good Steel

91740-complete.name: Merell Ross
91740-complete.text: We lost two members of the watch last week to the murlocs, $c. Hopefully with their leader slain, we can start pushing them out of Elwynn.
91740-complete.title: Croaky's Head

91777-progress.name: Brother Paxton
91777-progress.text: Have you found all my missing books yet?
91777-progress.title: Rare Books

92415-progress.name: Orphan Matron Nightingale
92415-progress.text: What is it, $N? What are you looking for?
92415-progress.title: Remember That I Love You

95041-progress.name: Jemma Quikswitch
95041-progress.text: How is the data retrieval progressing?
95041-progress.title: Data Hoarders

95189-complete.name: Lady Dena Kennedy
95189-complete.text:
How in the world did you find this? It's in such remarkable condition... all things considered.

Thank you for restoring this piece of Alliance history, $c. I'll have my best people get to work restoring this immediately.
95189-complete.title: Crest of Lordaeron

95189-progress.name: Lady Dena Kennedy
95189-progress.text: Welcome to the gallery. Feel free to browse.
95189-progress.title: Crest of Lordaeron

95195-progress.name: General Marcus Jonathan
95195-progress.text: You look as if you're carrying a heavy burden, $N. What is it?
95195-progress.title: Bloodied Insignia

95250-accept.name: Britt
95250-accept.text:
Ah, a fellow $r. It's about time Lordaeron sent reinforcements.

My master has already charged into the fray and has ordered me to maintain my post. It has been quite some time, however.

I don't dare trust this task to any of these filthy half breeds, but if I could impose on you a favor, I beg of you to find me the Grand Marshal. He is the tallest, most statuesque hero you've ever laid eyes on. You'll know him when you see him.
95250-accept.title: Abominable Creatures

95250-complete.name: Unknown
95250-complete.text:
<Truman looks at the head of his former lord in horror and disgust.>

Is this... some kind of joke? Why would you bring me this monstrosity's head?

Get out of my sight! I should have known better than to trust someone who allies themselves with the type of filth you do. The true sons of Lordaeron will reclaim our home. And when we do we'll finally be free to purge it of beasts and those who consort with them like you!
95250-complete.title: Abominable Creatures

95250-progress.name: Unknown
95250-progress.text: Good to see you're still alive and kicking! How fares the battle? Have you seen my lord?
95250-progress.title: Abominable Creatures

96390-accept.name: Earthseer Farsen
96390-accept.text:
Dark Iron spies have infiltrated Dun Morogh. To what end I canna' be sure, but this is a problem we need to nip in the bud before it is allowed to grow.

Head eastward to Ironband's Compound and kill the Dark Iron spies that you find there.
96390-accept.title: Nip 'Em in the Bud

96391-accept.name: Unknown
96391-accept.text:
<The map you are holding seems to show a complex series of underground tunnels and highways that all seem to converge on a point underneath Ironforge itself.

You can't be sure what the runes say as they are written in the ugly jagged rune language of the Dark Iron dwarves, but you can guess at the purpose of these tunnels. As you are reading the map, a gust of wind washes over you and you can faintly hear a dwarven voice carried on it. Earthseer Farsen needs to see this.>
96391-accept.title: Underground Map

96395-accept.name: Unknown
96395-accept.text:
The... Thane... my mighty... Thane... he... needs to... rest.

Please... help him... help him... rest...

Consumed... by... ancient... grudge... No... rest...
96395-accept.title: An Ancient Grudge

96395-complete.name: Unknown
96395-complete.text:
My... Thane... he... rests... yes... rest.

Thank... you...

I... rest...
96395-complete.title: An Ancient Grudge

96403-progress.name: Thom Filch
96403-progress.text: <Thom appears to absentmindedly rub his hands together as he looks at you.>
96403-progress.title: Important Heirlooms

98326-complete.name: Gretta Ganter
98326-complete.text:
Yer a real lifesaver, $N!

My husband would just laugh it off, but I couldn't bear tellin' him he has to spend another night on the lake. Maybe now we can enjoy a real feast.
98326-complete.title: Frosthowl

98326-progress.name: Gretta Ganter
98326-progress.text: It'll be a hot day in Dun Morogh before I tell Paxton I lost his entire stockpile to a wendigo.
98326-progress.title: Frosthowl

98423-accept.name: Unknown
98423-accept.text: Inside of the vault you find a tablet detailing the terms of a peace treaty between the Bronzebeard and Wildhammer dwarf clans. It appears to date back to time period just after the War of the Three Hammers, and is very likely a notable piece of dwarven history. The king of Ironforge would no doubt be interested in this artifact.
98423-accept.title: The Treaty of Understanding

98423-progress.name: King Magni Bronzebeard
98423-progress.text: What have you brought from the depths, $c.
98423-progress.title: The Treaty of Understanding
